{{Quote|I like the way you wear that; it isn't often I find someone who successfully leaves fashion's herd.|Chanty Colbon|<ref name="RM" />}}
'''Chanty Colbon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] passenger aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when it was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|hijacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]]. Charming and witty, he used a ruthlessness and ingratiating manner to convince other passengers to spend their money on him.
